description:
reindex.rs:131-148 — extract_message_id_bytes uses text.lines() which splits on bare 
/
 and never joins RFC 5322 continuation lines (lines starting with SP/HTAB). An article with a folded Message-ID header (e.g. 'Message-ID:
 <id@example.com>
') is accepted and stored by the live ingest path via extract_body_msgid (ingestion.rs:119), which correctly handles folding. During disaster-recovery reindex, the same article's Message-ID is not extracted — extract_message_id_bytes returns None — and the article is counted as skipped_not_article instead of being re-indexed. Result: after a reindex run, folded-Message-ID articles are invisible to msgid_map, breaking duplicate detection and group-log lookups for those articles.

Correct behavior: extract_message_id_bytes should handle RFC 5322 folding the same way extract_body_msgid does, or delegate to it directly.
title: S0: reindex extract_message_id_bytes misses folded Message-ID
